lead_headline: Dispatch reaches a stable delivery architecture as Claude Code weathers a rough triage day
lead_body: Seven commits landed in Dispatch overnight, covering the podcast page redesign, split-deployment CORS support, and the long-form brief mode generating this issue. The crossOrigin credential fix was the final piece needed for the Vercel-plus-cloudflared topology to function end to end. Upstream, Claude Code closed roughly a hundred issues in a sweep around 22:30 UTC while fresh bugs around ECONNRESET, PTY CPU spin, and --resume fork selection queued up.
lead_article:
The biggest movement today was inside Dispatch itself: seven commits spanning a podcast page redesign, the new dispatch-wide weekly cross-project digest, split-deployment CORS support for the Vercel-plus-cloudflared topology, and the long-form brief mode that's generating this very briefing. The crossOrigin credential fix on the audio player was the last piece needed for the split-deployment path to actually work end to end. That's a meaningful cluster — not incremental polish, but the delivery architecture reaching a new stable shape.

Astro had a productive morning: the sitemap index lastmod fix merged, the action-caching pipeline fix landed, and the Svelte testing-library type mismatch was closed out. A new PR addresses the SSR route-cache warning that 6.3.6 introduced — worth watching, since it's already generating noise in production logs. Workflow SDK merged two cookbook doc updates and has a handful of test PRs queued. Claude Code is having a rough day upstream — a mass closure of roughly a hundred issues around 22:30 UTC suggests a triage sweep rather than fixes, and fresh reports of ECONNRESET on parallel startup fetches, a 100%-CPU PTY EOF hang, and a --resume fork-selection bug are all sitting open. The AI SDK gained a containerUpload option for the Anthropic code-execution tool, quiet but worth noting for anything that eventually feeds into the homelab pipeline.
